mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% in a given month signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.5% in the current month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE rising above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and growth in economic demand (GDPC1) creates a favorable macro environment, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 both rise in the current month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline in the current month
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the industrial production index above 103.5 signals strong supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 103.5 in the current month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO rising above 103.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and growth in economic demand creates a favorable labor market and demand environment, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls and GDPC1 rises in the current month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls and GDPC1 rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime, a sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3.5% in the current month
failure_condition: In the tight labor market regime, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and housing demand (HOUST) indicates tightening monetary policy coupled with strong housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and HOUST both rise in the current month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and HOUST rise concurrently.
